translation: In the end, the harm of recklessness is five in ten, and the harm of indulgence is eight in ten. Then they begin to use their hands to leave it to later people, saying: I will just slowly not move, and not make it great. They do not know that the evil qi deepens day by day, the primordial qi is shaved away day by day, and the great life has already followed it. What is called the mediocre minister ruining the state and the mediocre physician ruining people have the same circumstances and equal guilt, and their origin is all rooted in not learning. If they learned and exhaustively investigated the sources of disease of past and present, and carefully examined the formulas and strategies of past and present, whether the disease is in the branch or in the root, whether the formula should supplement or drain, whether the disease is transmitted or transformed, and whether the formula is not rigid and not constrained, then that one who stored mugwort for three years and could treat before the disease arose, and that one who with one spoon restored life and could treat after the disease had arisen, are all the minds that the former sages and worthies exhausted in their day, and all the formulas and strategies that the healers of the state and healers of the people had long possessed. The weak one understands principle; why not urgently study and discuss, and play with human life? This is why my friend Jingtong, exploring the subtlety of life and destiny, with the pain he cherished, and with the aim of loving learning without weariness, guides people with the method of broadly giving and saving the multitude. First he carved the 《Waitai Miyao》, and then supplemented the 《Shengji Zonglu》 (General Records of Sagely Benevolence). To give long life to the state and to the people is all contained in this work. Is Master Cheng's merit not great?
